result.detail: Inputs used: the approved spec content [artifact:prj-de4daabcef.interface-spec.a1] (review record [evidence:prj-de4daabcef.interface-spec.e1]) and the approved RTL [artifact:prj-de4daabcef.design-under-test.a1] (review record [evidence:prj-de4daabcef.design-under-test.e1]). I read the RTL only for port names and widths; the model's behaviour comes from the spec text. The nonce is printed byte by byte, skipping NUL bytes, so leading padding in the packed string does not corrupt the verdict line under either Icarus or Verilator. Random stimulus comes from an in-file xorshift32 with a fixed seed (32'hC0FFEE01), so runs are repeatable and do not depend on simulator $random behaviour. The testbench has no watchdog, so that only one verdict line can ever be printed. The evidence requirements still open are the simulator.run on the approved RTL and an independent review record; neither is claimed here.
